landing._comment: Where fresh characters spawn (must match server-settings.json startPoints). The gamemode moves them into the hub from here. Bruma arrival while the Whiterun landing hangs the first load.

welcome: Welcome to DragonBreak Online. Type /help for commands.

jail._comment: Jail zones and sentences (server\jail.js). Every jail and prison in the load order is in jail-cells.json (ck-mcp/jails.py, 25 cells); cells adds more here, and admins add more in game with /jail add (kept in jails.json, untracked). No /unstuck inside a jail or while serving. A guard or official uses a cell door with a player in reach to imprison them for one of minutes; time counts only while the prisoner is online and in the jail. pickChance: a non-Lockpicker's chance to pick a cell door, a Lockpicker's at Novice, what each tier adds, the ceiling; a failure breaks the pick.

struggle._comment: Breaking free of bound hands with /struggle (server\struggle.js): strikes landed in a row, band half-width in percent of the bar (watchedBand while anyone lawful other than the captor is within watchMeters, who is told; the captor is always told and never narrows it), sweepMs for the first crossing of the bar, multiplied by speedUp after each landed strike down to minSweepMs, seconds per attempt, one miss fails. winChance is the chance a clean round frees the captive, the most a scripted client can reach. cooldownMinutes between attempts, kept on the character. nearbyMeters hear about a break-out. whileCarried false refuses a carried captive. The escape grace before recapture is captureEscapeGraceMs in server-settings.json (20000 by default).

ropeUnattended._comment: A rope captive left unattended (server\rope.js): the gap, the chance a clean round frees them and the wait between tries, in place of band, winChance and cooldownMinutes above. The wait counts from the start of the last try. With the captor near, a rope captive plays the round above.

rope._comment: Tying someone up without authority (server\rope.js with captureSystem.ts; Nate, 2026-09-30). item: the Rope a binding uses, one per knot. A player carrying one ties a downed player at once, or a conscious one who says yes; never on sight. Unattended: the captor more than unattendedMeters away, in another cell or down, for unattendedAfterSeconds in a row. Unattended time adds up and pauses while the captor is back; the captive is warned at warnMinutes and the rope slips off at slipMinutes. cutFree: anyone else standing within cutReach units cuts a rope captive free in cutSeconds, broken if either moves more than cutMoveUnits (rope only, never shackles). Animations are Helgen's (MQ101, where Hadvar or Ralof cuts the player's binds), sent with Debug.SendAnimationEvent on that player; empty plays nothing: cutFreeIdle on the rescuer as the cut starts, cutFreeStop when a cut breaks, cutFreeCaptiveIdle on the captive at the end while still bound, then the release cutFreeReleaseMs later, tieIdle on the captor at the knot. If the player's graph lacks them, IdleLockPick or IdleSearchingTable; never a paired pa_ idle. The refusal hold and the escape grace are ropeRefusalHoldMs and ropeEscapeGraceMs in server-settings.json (2 min and 60 s by default).

spells._comment: Spell study (server\spells.js). A tome is learned only at a skills.json spellStudyPoints entry, by a reader with the school's skill (arcane or priest) taken up, a tier that allows the tome's rank, and a free slot; slots 0 uses the skill's spellSlots (3). /teach: a teacher at teacherMinTier (3 = Expert) teaches a known spell to a player within teachMeters at studentMinTier (1 = Apprentice) or higher; teachAtStudyPoint also requires both at a study point. /tomes: the court mage's shop in shopCells (the Synod Conclave and its basement), for members of shopFactions with arcane or priest at shopMinTier or higher, ranks up to their tier and never above shopMaxRank (3 = Expert), one tome per shopCooldownDays, price = tome value x shopPriceMultiplier, paid to the shopTreasury zone.
spells._guildWorkshops: Refs only members of shopFactions may use: the Synod Conclave's enchanting table, whose CYRBlockedFactionWorkshop script (faction: the Synod) the server never runs (Nate, 2026-09-30).

charters._comment: Faction charters (server\charters.js, Jake's to-do "Faction button", 1 Oct): a player founds a faction (a company or a cult) by charter; a GM approves it. Founder, Officer and Sergeant on three accounts before it is submitted, up to maxFounders (5); the ranks are the seven roles of the faction guide; a seat only a property a founding member owns; no fee (fee 0); the lore's factions refused; disbanding by a GM's approval, its treasury to the Founder. Every other key (charters.js DEFAULTS) may be set here too. Off until switched on.

schools._comment: Schools of magic (server\schools.js, Swag's rework, Nate 2026-09-30). A mage chooses a primary school from `schools` (K, Arcane Arts page, or at a Study Magic shelf); the rest lock until Arcane Arts reaches secondaryAtLevel, when one secondary may be chosen, starting at secondaryStartLevel. Each school is a 0-100 meter on the Wheel's curve (Novice 1, Apprentice 25, Adept 50, Expert 75, Master 90) and a tome of it is read only up to its rank. Casting an active school's spell adds castUnits (repeats worth less), at most castDailyUnits a school a day. study: a ref in `refs` (the Synod Conclave's seven bookcases) or a base with editor id `edid` (Nate's StudyMagic activator, DLE v8: the Conclave, Frostcrag Spire, the College of Winterhold) opens Study Magic: unitsPerTick every tickSeconds to the primary while the reader stays within moveLimitMeters, minutesPerWindow in any rolling windowHours, closed once a spell learned through Arcane Arts is in the spellbook. classes: a Class Lectern (base editor id `edid`: Nate's ClassLectern activator in DLE v7, two boxes per lectern at the Synod, Frostcrag Spire and the Hall of the Elements, listed in `lecterns`; boxes within sameLecternUnits are one lectern); a teacher on the staff list (/classteacher, when requireList), in teacherGuilds, at teacherMinRank (3 = Expert) in the school, sets a class by one known spell; students sign up in the first joinMinutes; after `minutes` the teacher ends it and each student in the classroom (the lectern's interior cell, or radiusMeters outdoors) gets units x scale[student rank][class rank]; graceMinutes away cancels (teacher) or drops (student); cooldowns teacherCooldownMinutes after a finished class, studentCooldownHours between paid classes. Study and classes also credit Arcane Arts through masterySystem's cast credit (wheel), inside the Wheel's hourly and daily limits. requireClient: the gate and panels only for clients whose UI reports the 'schools' capability. Off until the client pack with the school meters and the two panels is out.
schools._alteration: Nate, 2026-09-30: Alteration is both Priest's and Arcane Arts'. both: a tome or lesson is taken through Priest's tier or through the Alteration school (Arcane Arts' tier and the school's rank), and goes into that path's book; a cast credits Arcane Arts and the school for a mage who chose Alteration, Priest otherwise, never both (masterySystem's cast route; without it the cast stays Priest's). arcane: the school's path alone. priest: Priest's alone, and Alteration is no school.

classes._scale: Rows: the student's rank in the class's school (Novice..Master); columns: the class spell's rank. Swag's table; his 'reduced' (Apprentice in a Novice class) is 0.35 and his 'XP' (Expert in a Master class) 0.7 (Nate, 2026-09-30).

regions._comment: Province rules (server\regions.js; data regions.json from ck-mcp\regions.py, hand rules regions-overrides.json). craft: a creation recipe is refused outside the provinces its product belongs to (turn on after the in-game rollback test). tomes: /tomes stocks only what spells.shopProvince sells; spells.shopShowForeign lists the rest as blocked rows. adminBypass: admins pass both unless /region test. failOpen: a recipe or tome with no entry is allowed and logged once. defaultPlace: the province of a place no table knows. freeBenches and freeWhy: cooking is known everywhere (Nate, 2026-09-30, after Cooked Boar Meat was refused in Bruma as a Solstheim design): a recipe at one of these benches, or one regions.py tags with one of these reasons, is never refused; a regions-overrides.json entry for that recipe still decides it.

raceStyles._comment: A people's own style is made by that race anywhere, and by anyone in its home province (Nate, 2026-09-30: race plus home province; server\RACE_STYLES_PROPOSAL.md). family = a recipe's c tag in regions.json; edid / notEdid = regexes on the recipe's editor id. Food and place-bound benches never follow race. Bretons wait for High Rock content.

factionGear._comment: Faction gear (server\factiongear.js; list faction-gear.json from tools/faction_gear.py): a faction's armor and weapons are crafted only by its Blacksmith (forge) or Tailor (loom, tanning rack) rank or its leader. enabled: on (Nate, 2026-09-28: make faction gear turned on); false turns it off for players, and an admin's /factiongear test still holds them to it either way. adminBypass: admins pass unless in test mode.

mastery._comment: Combat numbers (gamemode.js). damage.byTier: extra weapon damage by the attacker's weapon-skill rank, Novice..Master, applied after the engine's hit. defense.armorMultByTier: how many times its bare rating worn armor counts for, by the target's Defense rank (the engine alone gives rating x 0.12 %, capped at 80 %); lightShare: the part of that gain light armor gets (1 = same as heavy). Measured 2026-09-24: a naked player has 150 health; a Master two-hander with a Daedric greatsword dealt 33 a hit at the old x1.30 (5 hits). At x2.0 it is 48 (4 hits, 2 with a power attack); a full Daedric heavy set (108) worn at Master Defense takes 45 % off instead of 13 %.

arcane._comment: Extra damage for Destruction spells (schools: magic skill actor value, 20 = Destruction) by the caster's Arcane Arts rank, Novice..Master. Smaller than the weapon tiers because spells hit from range. Live magnitudes 2026-09-25: Firebolt 25, Fireball 40, Icy Spear 60.

castBlocks._comment: Spells refused before the server systems see the cast (gamemode.js castHook), with what the caster is told. For spells that crash the game.
castBlocks.782c5:BSHeartland.esm: Summon Will-o-the-Wisp is disabled for now: the wisp crashes the game when it appears. It will come back once that is fixed.

supernatural._comment: Overrides for supernatural.js defaults. huntMarkChance: the chance that surviving Hircine's Great Hunt (/rite) gives Sanies Lupinus; an unmarked survivor waits riteFailCooldownHours to run it again. infectWerewolf: a werewolf's bite's chance to pass it on. Nate, 2026-09-27: werewolf harder to come by than vampirism, 0.5 -> 0.25 and 0.05 -> 0.02.

feedPair._comment: The standing bite played for both players (client 0.3.71). Off until Nate has seen it in game; the release checks it is written here as false.

npcPowerHits._comment: How hard a creature's or NPC's power attack lands on a player (gamemode.js npcPowerHitMult). The server's damage formula doubles every power attack flat, on top of the NPC-on-player x2 in server-settings, ignoring the attack's own multiplier (1.0 for most creature power attacks), so a boar bit a new character for half their health (Purr, 30 Sep). 0.5 undoes that flat x2; 1 changes nothing. Players' own power attacks and hits on NPCs are never touched. Hot reload.

npcDamage._comment: byKind scales every hit one kind of creature or NPC lands on a player (gamemode.js npcKindDamageMult), on top of npcPowerHits; the kind is the middle of the attacker's wild:<kind>:... spawn tag (wildlife.js, owned-spawns.json). Players' own hits, PvP and hits on NPCs are never touched. Empty until Nate sets a value: the proposal for Bruma's boars (BSKEncBoar01, level 7, unarmed 25) is boar 0.4, a 20-point bite on a new character (150 health) instead of 50, so they survive 7 bites and go down on the 8th (Worker F, 1 Oct). Hot reload. takenByKind scales the hits a player, or someone fighting for one (ff_companionOf), lands on a creature or NPC of that kind (gamemode.js npcTakenDamageMult): above 1 they die faster, the extra taken off before the engine's blow on a weapon hit so that blow kills. Empty until set: the proposal for boars is 5 (a new character's iron sword 7 -> 35 a blow, a 200-health boar in 6 blows instead of 29; dagger or fists 10 instead of 50).

pvp._comment: damageMult scales every player-on-player hit after skills and armor (1 = unchanged). 1.25 from 2026-09-25 (Nat: PvP damage buffed a bit).

business._comment: Business ledgers (business.js). An owner opens a property as a business; owner and staff set the inn's bed rent (minRent..maxRent), keep a logbook and put chests up for rent (up to maxChestPrice a day; chestGraceHours to empty after the rent ends). Each hold's rent tax is set by taxRanks, 0..maxTax; until then rest.holdShare stands.

combat._comment: Skill-based fights (combat.js, COMBAT_DESIGN.md), player targets only, needs the C++ hit flags. A blocked blow lets weaponChip (shieldChip with a shield) through, less chipPerDefenseTier per Defense rank; the blocker pays the rest in stamina (x shieldStaminaMult with a shield, x powerIntoShieldStaminaMult more for a power attack into a shield). At 0 stamina, or hit by a bash, the guard breaks: a stagger and guardBreakSeconds of blocked blows landing in full. Unblocked power attacks stagger; a weapon-skill rank of powerStaggerThroughWeaponBlockRank staggers through a weapon block. A bash deals bashDamageMult of the weapon and staggers unless the target's Defense rank is bashStaggerResistRank or more (3 = Expert). One stagger per target every staggerCooldownSeconds.

manuals._comment: Smithing manuals and smithing skill books (server\manuals.js, manuals.json; Nate 2026-09-30). A manual below the reader's Blacksmith tier is refused and kept; learning it adds its marker and uses the book up (consume) at the reader's next cell change, logout or login, never under an open menu. shop: the Synod sells manuals up to maxTier at the Scholars' Ledger in its Conclave (cells) for priceMultiplier x the book's value, into the treasury. loot: one roll per boss chest and expedition master, chance by difficulty, tier up to maxTier by difficulty, rareTier drawn at rareWeight, staffTier never (given in roleplay with /manual grant, Lead GM and above). provinces: where a material's manual may drop (loot.json's province ids; a material not listed drops anywhere, an empty list nowhere), from regions-overrides.json's families. copy: a Scholar at or above a manual's tier copies one they learned at a Scholars' Ledger for `paper` of paperId, inside reading.bookDailyCap. skillBooks: a book teaching actor value `av` (10, Smithing) is Blacksmith work once per book per character, weight units through masterySystem's award.

salvage._comment: Breaking gear and books down into materials (salvage.js, salvage.json from tooling/make_salvage.py). Using a smelter (Blacksmith), tanning rack (Skinner), loom (Tailor) or writing desk (Scholar) offers what the player carries that it can take apart. A share of the item's recipe comes back by the player's tier in that skill (shareByTier, Novice..Master), rounded down, at least one of the main material; a Blacksmith needs the tier that works the main metal. Books: a bound book gives bookPaper paper (the paper item) and bookStrips leather strips, a note notePaper paper. pageSize rows per page; the first row works the station, arming one pass for useWindowSeconds.

martialArts._comment: Martial Arts (martial.js; the skill id stays unarmed). staminaDamage: every melee blow (fists and weapons, not bows or spells, NPCs' too) is full at fullAt of the attacker's stamina or more and falls linearly to minMult at none. fists.drainByTier: stamina points a landed fist takes from its target by the attacker's Martial Arts rank (untrainedDrain without the skill), x powerDrainMult for a power attack; armorExtra: how much more the target's armour counts against fists; powerDisarm: a landed unarmed power attack unequips a player's weapons (combat.js disarm cooldown), from powerDisarmMinRank. staves.armorPierce: the share of the armour's reduction a staff ignores. Fist tier damage is mastery.damage.fistByTier; staves use byTier.

weaponMaterials._comment: Extra damage by the weapon's material keyword (editor id), on top of its base damage, for hits by players (playersOnly) in every fight. Vanilla puts Daedric (sword 14) and Dragonbone (15) one point apart; with this Dragonbone hits about 16% harder than Daedric and a Daedric sword about 2.4x an Iron one. Keywords from Skyrim.esm, Dawnguard (DLC1) and Dragonborn (DLC2), and Saints & Seducers' Madness (as Daedric), and ArmorMaterialDragonplate, which Immersive Weapons puts on its Dragonsteel weapons (as Dragonbone; only weapons read this list), so tier 5 always out-hits tier 4 (Nate, 2026-09-30; tools/recipes/t4_below_t5.py). Amber (as Glass, 0.13) is held until the PC ladder run's plugin lowers its stats: with the bonus on today's records an Amber sword (16.95) out-hits a Daedric one (16.80) (Worker D's review); a weapon without one of these gets nothing.

armorMaterials._comment: Rating an armor material counts for, by slot, when higher than its records give (gamemode.js armorPieceOf). The engine keeps the record's rating; the server counts this one where Defense and tempering count (the hit's armor reduction) and shows it in the inventory. Nate, 2026-09-29: Dragonbone and Dragonscale above Ebony. Dragonplate (Update.esm) already beats Ebony piece for piece (46/17/17/22/34 against 43/16/16/21/32); Dragonscale (41/12/12/17/29, light) now counts one above Ebony on every piece. Daedric stays on top (49/18/18/23/36).

pickpocket._comment: Sneak + X on a player (pickpocket.js). chance: chanceUntrained, or chanceByTier by Lockpicking tier, + behindBonus (outside a behindConeDegrees cone of the face), - weaponDrawnPenalty, within min/maxChance. A success takes goldShareByTier of the coin (at most goldMax) or one pocket item (never a worn copy, never a key); the victim notices noticeAfterSeconds later. Failure warns the victim at once. Waits: cooldownSeconds per thief, sameTargetMinutes per thief and victim, victimMinutes per victim. Lockpicking credit for creditMinGold or an item, never a party member, creditsPerHour at most. exclude: item descs never taken.

reading._comment: Scholar book mini-game. The candle burns baseSeconds + secondsPerWord for each word of the sentence; a wrong reading burns wrongPenaltySeconds off it and locks in the words already right. wordsByTier is the sentence length (min, max) per Scholar tier, Novice to Master. cooldownMinutes before the same book can be read again, loseCooldownMinutes after the candle gutters.

champions._comment: Named champion spawns: chance a hostile wildlife or dungeon spawn is promoted, how much bigger it stands, the share of each hit given back to it (0.5 is roughly double health), the gold each fighter is paid, the chance of a gem on top, and the share of the damage a player needs to count as a fighter.

glow._comment: Which shader lights a glowing chest, barrel or salt deposit (server\glowshader.js). The client's defaults for loot and locked (LifeDetected 146, LifeDetectedUndead AAEB3) are particle-only and draw nothing on a container or an activator (GroundedPasta, 30 Sep). membrane true names these membrane shaders in every dboGlow packet instead; a 0.3.73+ client plays them, an older one ignores the field. Off until Nate's console check (pms 10272e on a chest). Hot reload.

labour._comment: Mining and woodcutting mini-game: seconds per round, strike band half-width in percent of the bar by tier, seconds the marker takes to cross the bar by tier, how many strikes a vein needs, ore per vein before the tier multiplier, firewood per block by tier, and the rest each node takes afterwards.

saltGlow._comment: Sea Salt Deposits glow while they hold salt for you and go dark while the seam rests (GroundedPasta, 30 Sep: very small, very hard to see). audience: miners (Miner taken up) or everyone. The list is salt-deposits.json (tools/labour/salt_deposits.py). Hot reload.

needs._comment: Hunger: 0 sated .. 100 starving, rises only while online. Stages apply regen penalties on the owner client (StaminaRateMult / HealRateMult, percent) and xpMult scales skill progress (0.25 = a quarter rate). Food kinds by ALCH food flag + editor-id words; potions/poisons give 0.

wildlife._comment: Outdoor creatures from wildlife.json: spawn radius (units), despawn when nobody is near, respawn after a kill, which leveled option (low/mid/high), giant camp chest cooldown per player.

safeZones._comment: Pale Pass arrival for the Bruma playtest: only the weakest creature of each spot (no ogres or trolls on the first stretch of road).
Bruma city surroundings (user request 2026-09-16): weakest creature of each spot, so wolves instead of ogres around the walls.

ownedSpawns._comment: Creatures the owned plugins place (owned-spawns.json, wildlife.js). factions: per wildlife kind, the factions each spawned creature is given (ff_factions, applied by the client) so camp-mates are allies instead of fighting each other (Dusk Thorn Camp, 30 Sep; the boars of Bruma, GroundedPasta 30 Sep 04:03: four fought each other five seconds after they spawned, before any player hit). Descs: CreatureFaction 13:Skyrim.esm, CYRGoblinFaction 877f5:BSHeartland.esm, CYRBoarFaction 6da79:BSHeartland.esm (each allied to itself, with no other relation; BSKEncBoar01 has CreatureFaction only, like the goblin templates).

animalBody._comment: What E on a dead wild animal hands over (gamemode.js __dboAnimalBody). A part is an item whose record type is in allowTypes, or one of partTypes whose editor id matches a pattern in allowEditorIds; denyEditorIds wins over both. The rest (gems, gold, jewelry, soul gems, potions, dishes, weapons, armour) is thrown away with the body. keepAllKinds lists wildlife kinds (the middle of a wild:<kind>:<n> tag, e.g. giant) whose bodies keep everything. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, case-sensitive.
animalBody._addFood: Meat for animals whose death item has none (Nate, 30 Sep). creature is a pattern on the dead body's own editor id (a wolf spot also spawns bears and boars); first match wins; each item is added once per death unless the body already holds it. names is for reading only.

playtest._comment: Region lock for the Bruma playtest (server/playtest.js). Hub gates lead to the arrival spot; blockedDoors refuse; anyone outside allowedWorlds / interiors from allowedPlugins / allowedCells is returned (allowedCells: Bruma interiors made in our own plugins, e.g. CYRBrumaBank in DragonBreak Online Edits.esp). blockedDoors refuse admins too; admins are not returned. Set enabled false to open all of Skyrim.
playtest.name: Bruma

arrival._comment: Cyrodiil side of the Pale Pass road: arrival marker of the Skyrim border door 14df:BSHeartland.esm (its return door 656df is blocked).

pigeons._comment: Pigeon price: baseFee plus goldPerKm for the distance flown, capped at maxFee; a pigeon to another land costs maxFee. Paid into the treasury of the hold it is sent from.

respawnTemples._comment: Bruma deaths respawn at the cathedral door (user decision 2026-09-16). The login hang there was vanilla creature pathing, fixed by disabling Bruma's plugin creatures (HANDOFF section 14). Hub gates still lead to the Pale Pass arrival.

dungeons._comment: exclude: dungeon ids never leased. AbandonedPrisonLocation is out because its main cell is now Windhelm's prison, a jail (Nat, 2026-09-23); its other cell is the spare prison template.

ayleidLoot._comment: Ayleid treasure from ayleid-loot.json, by the lease's difficulty (Nate, 2026-09-28). chestChance: a big chest holds one piece; bossChance: the boss chest. chest/boss: tier weights (common, uncommon, rare = Major jewellery and Shocks arms, rarest = Eminent jewellery and the Lich Helmet). raidBossChance/raidBoss: a raid's boss chests and masters. These pieces never come from the general pools. ruins: expeditions, or all to add Bruma's own Ayleid ruins.

expeditionLoot._comment: Expedition loot, one place to tune (Nate, 2026-09-28: trim it). scale per difficulty: every roll's chance in an expedition's chests, urns and bodies, and every coin amount (a boss chest's coin and its piece of gear stay certain). bossScale: the same for a boss chest's and a master's other rolls. containerScale: urns and sacks roll at scale x this and hold one thing at most. arrows/containerArrows: stack sizes. enchScale, ayleidScale: enchanted gear and Ayleid treasure chances. ordinary: true gives ordinary dungeons the same trim (Nate 2026-09-28); false leaves them untrimmed (Nate 2026-09-30, after players found almost nothing). A raid's extra boss roll: raid.bossRolls.

dungeons._lootExtras: torchChance: a chest's torch roll in ordinary dungeons, expeditionTorchChance in the dark Ayleid ruins (both times the trim). bodyGearChance (expeditionBodyGearChance in the ruins, which keep their trim): a humanoid body hands over one plain piece of the weapon or armor it carried, times the trim (groundedpasta, 2026-09-29: bandits dropped nothing).

raid._comment: Boss dungeons and raids (Nate, 2026-09-28; expeditions.json kind). A raid's bosses pick bossBandShift level bands up (a boss dungeon's 1), each brings escorts[difficulty] of its room's nearest enemy (scaled with the party), its other enemies are countMult as many, and its boss chests and masters give bossRolls boss rolls (1.5: a second roll half the time). bossDungeonMax: the most a boss dungeon takes (0: no cap).

potions._comment: How often dungeon loot holds a potion (Nate, 2026-09-28: less common). chest/boss: a big or boss chest holds one; container: an urn or sack; body: a humanoid body; corpseKeep: a creature keeps a potion it carried. strongWeight: a potion of rank r is drawn with weight 1/r^strongWeight.

downed._comment: Down state (server\downed.js). potion: the Draught of Revival, brewed at any alchemy lab by an Alchemist of potion.tier who has read its recipe, from exactly one of potion.recipes (one of each ingredient, any order). names are shown to players (vanilla names are localized string ids, so they are given here). _alternatives are not read.

war._comment: War and raids stay off until the holds and factions are set up during the alpha (Nate, 2026-09-26). colours: the Realm map's lore colour per faction (Nate's picks; the cults' and the Vigil's chosen by the Prince's or the order's motif); "base/stripe" draws a stripe (the Companions). seats: where a faction that is not a hold musters to declare, { id: { name, world, pos, radius, cells } }.

economy._comment: Weekly taxes and wages (economy.js). On from 2026-09-28 (Nate: "economy needs to fully be turned on"); the review B2 guards are in economy.js.

contracts._comment: Hunting contracts (server\contracts.js). Off 2026-09-28 to 2026-09-30 (claude-jake review A1-1: officials could post and take their own contracts and drain the hold treasury). On again (Nate, 2026-09-30) with the poster, cap and escrow rules in place, kills counted only in the notice's own hold, and players taking work on the Contracts tab of the expedition board.

tickets._comment: In-game /ticket (gameticket.js, consolidation C9): the players who were within 40 m when a ticket opens are posted to this staff-only channel (#ticket-archive, named by claude-jake 2026-09-28), never into the ticket the reporter reads.

beastform._comment: vampireLordRemoteRace: whether other players see the Vampire Lord body. Off since the 2026-09-29 crash breaker trip; /vlremote on|off changes it and beastform-state.json keeps that choice across restarts and deploys. werewolfRemoteRace: the same for a werewolf (on; /wwremote on|off, kept in the same file). Off stops the watcher crashes from a werewolf's relayed howls until the client guard (0.3.72+) is live, at the cost of watchers seeing a human play the werewolf's animations.

offlineBody._comment: A logged-out player's body cannot be harmed (Nate, 2026-09-30), unless a blow landed on or by them in the last combatLogSeconds before the logout (combat logging). 0 = every logged-out body is safe.

playtesterBoost._comment: The playtesters' reward at the alpha launch (playtesterboost.js, Nate 2026-09-30): a holder of roleId (the pre-alpha whitelist role) gets hours of x mult skill progress from their first login at or after startsAt, once per account, if that login is before claimUntil. Needs a server build whose masterySystem honours private.xpBoost (fork client-playtester-xpboost); without one nothing starts and nothing is promised. enabled gates only the automatic start; running windows and staff /boost grant|extend work either way. Windows live in playtester-boost.json.
